
 Usage: houston doctor [OPTIONS]

 Preflight: check Docker, Compose, disk, connectivity and ports.

╭─ Options ──╮
 --json                  print the report as one JSON envelope; exits 3 on any failing check
 --context        <str>  report on this Kubernetes cluster by kubeconfig context name, as `up
                         --context` would use it
 --help                  Show this message and exit.
╰──╯
